interpretation_limits: Matched comparisons isolate a configuration change within the fixed method; they do not uniquely identify every downstream mechanism.
Adam normalizes first-step coordinate magnitudes: softer teacher weights need not proportionally reduce the first state step.
Anchor loss and update magnitude are process measures, not localization accuracy.
Teacher GT quality groups are offline explanations only and never drive per-video parameter choice.
All intervals are exploratory development results with multiple comparisons, not independent confirmation.
